info.title: OpsPilot Agent Connector
info.description: Calls OpsPilot's agentic IT-ops assistant (Claude API tool-use loop) and returns a single aggregated result: a final answer plus any drafted offboarding/hygiene/SLA-risk report artifacts. Names, emails, and usernames are redacted before reaching Claude and rehydrated in this response - see the OpsPilot README's Honesty notes for exact scope.

post.description: Runs the OpsPilot tool-use loop to completion against the bundled demo dataset or a previously-uploaded dataset, and returns the final answer plus any drafted report artifacts. This blocks until the loop finishes (typically a few seconds, longer for multi-step requests that draft several artifacts) - there is no live progress feed on this endpoint, unlike the browser demo's trace panel.

message.description: The ticket text or request for OpsPilot to act on, e.g. a new ticket's summary and description.

api_key.description: An Anthropic API key. Passed per-request today, matching OpsPilot's current design - see the connector README for a note on moving this to connection-level auth instead.

dataset_id.description: Optional. Omit to run against the bundled synthetic demo dataset. Provide the id returned by a prior /api/upload call to run against an uploaded dataset instead.

name.description: The tool OpsPilot called, e.g. query_accounts, query_tickets, or draft_report.

input.description: The arguments OpsPilot passed to that tool call.

reportType.description: One of offboarding_ticket, sla_risk_report, or account_hygiene_report.

body.description: The full drafted artifact content, in markdown - this is what a flow would post into Teams, email, or a ticketing system.

status.description: Always states this is a draft only - OpsPilot never submits to a real system itself.

"ok" or "error". A flow should branch on this field, not on the HTTP status code - this endpoint returns HTTP 200 even when status is "error" (e.g. an invalid API key or the agent hitting its turn limit), since that's a normal, expected outcome to handle, not a transport failure.

answer.description: The agent's final answer text. Null when status is "error".

tool_calls.description: Every tool call the agent made, in order - useful for a flow that wants to log or branch on what actually happened.

draft_reports.description: Every draft_report artifact the agent produced during this run, if any.

error.description: Present only when status is "error" - a human-readable description of what went wrong.
